_comment: Secondary-figure pass A, 2026-08-22. Real named people other than the card subject who appear in the p0*, p1* and p2* chapters - in the origin stories and in the teaching bodies from the first <h2> onward. Card subjects are in src/assets/licences.json and belong to another pass; the p3* chapters belong to secondary pass B, which also writes sec-* files. Every licence below was read off the file's own Commons description page via the extmetadata API and confirmed against the raw licence template in the page wikitext, never off an article that uses the file. Files are downscaled to 480px on the long edge, EXIF stripped, JPEG q82 progressive, never cropped: the book crops in CSS. Nothing here is NC, ND, fair-use or press-kit. The 'triage' object below lists every person considered, including the misses with what was searched and the invented engineers ruled out, so a later pass does not re-litigate them.
